semanticReview.method: Seguimiento por entrada: cotejo manual de la ficha canónica con pasajes primarios consultables, localizadores APA 7 y evaluación canónica local; no se elevaron hallazgos parciales a VERIFIED.
findings: Seguimiento de fuente primaria: se comprobó el localizador Pre-intermediate, Lesson 9, p. 29 (compiled PDF p. 211): V-ない/V-ません plain-style correspondence; Elementary 1, Lesson 18, p. 21 (compiled PDF p. 120): verb non-past/past and negative forms. en Irodori. Supports the core non-past negative forms; the full range of habitual/future readings and all examples are not all stated in these passages.
La cobertura claim-level sigue incompleta; se conserva PENDING_SOURCE_SUPPORT y no se declara VERIFIED.
limitations: Supports the core non-past negative forms; the full range of habitual/future readings and all examples are not all stated in these passages.
No se creó Evidence VERIFIED. La entrada permanece pendiente.
